> Also the snap settings accept any arbitrary text with no feedback. This is most noticeable when I mistakenly type a comma instead of a dot as a decimal separator. Inspector fields handle this gracefully (I love it).

This has a bespoke solution in EditorSpinSlider: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/be3ecaeb3c51433058ad4e96ec892d18f4291efd/editor/gui/editor_spin_slider.cpp#L570-L571

The easiest way is to make this dialog use EditorSpinSlider instead of LineEdit. (I don't know why these weren't using SpinBox in the first place though, considering that's meant to be used for numeric data and was already present in Godot 1.0.)

The 2D editor's Configure Snap dialog uses SpinBox at least, so it handles expressions but doesn't support using commas as decimal separators due to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/80699#issuecomment-2892493782.
